title: 历史：身体的历史 — Day 56
title_en: History: A History of the Body — Day 56

questions.question: 1829 年维莱尔梅把法国各省的纳税额和因身高不足免役的比例对照，得出了什么结论？
options: 决定身高地区差的主要是纬度和气候：越靠南的省，年轻人越矮
身高与贫富无关，征兵档案的测量误差太大，无法得出地区差异
决定身高地区差的主要是贫困：越穷的省，被判太矮的年轻人越多
决定身高地区差的主要是血统：不同「种族」来源的省份身高不同
questions.explanation: 当时的主流解释是气候与「种族」，维莱尔梅用一条近乎单调的关系推翻了它：贫困才是关键，身体第一次成了可比较的经济指标。这套为凑兵员定的尺子，后来也成了检验「总量增长是否落到人身上」的方法。
questions.question_en: In 1829 Villermé matched each French department's tax receipts against its share of young men exempted for being too short. What did he conclude?
options_en: Latitude and climate mainly drove regional height differences: the farther south, the shorter the young men
Height was unrelated to wealth; conscription records were too error-prone to show any regional pattern
Poverty mainly drove regional height differences: the poorer the department, the more young men were too short
Ancestry mainly drove regional height differences: departments of different "racial" origin differed in height
questions.explanation_en: The prevailing explanations were climate and "race," and Villermé overturned them with a nearly monotonic relationship: poverty was what mattered, making the body a comparable economic indicator for the first time. A rule meant to fill army ranks became a way to test whether aggregate growth reaches people's bodies.

questions.question: 鲍嘉兰与盖茨走访近一千八百名高龄乡村女性后发现，缠足在哪里最早退场？
options: 天足会和维新派宣传最密集、反缠足话语传播最广的地方
机制纱线和洋布最先进来、家庭手工纺织收入垮掉的地方
1928 年内政部禁令颁布后，警察检查力度最大的地方
1902 年劝戒缠足懿旨下达后，地方官执行最严格的地方
questions.explanation: 她们发现缠足的分布与女孩的久坐手工劳动高度重合：手工纺织收入一垮，缠脚就从投资变成纯负担，风俗才塌。清初的禁令下过却无果，说明仅靠政令与倡导不够；当然也有批评者认为经济解释低估了民族主义话语的动员力。
questions.question_en: After interviewing nearly 1,800 elderly rural women, Laurel Bossen and Hill Gates found that footbinding disappeared earliest where?
options_en: Where anti-footbinding societies and reformers campaigned hardest and the message spread widest
Where machine-spun yarn and factory cloth arrived first and household hand-textile income collapsed
Where police inspections were most intense after the 1928 Interior Ministry ban
Where local officials enforced the 1902 imperial edict discouraging footbinding most strictly
questions.explanation_en: They found footbinding tracked girls' sedentary handicraft labor: once hand-spinning income collapsed, binding turned from an investment into a pure burden, and the custom fell. Early Qing bans had already failed, showing decrees and advocacy alone weren't enough, though critics argue the economic account underrates nationalist mobilization.

questions.question: 1977 年 504 条款占楼抗议带来的「真正转折」，放到团队管理里最贴切的应用是哪一个？
options: 先查清成员表现不佳的个人原因，再决定是否需要调岗或者安排培训
对表现不佳的成员给予更多同情和宽容，但不改变团队现有的任何流程
为表现不佳的成员单独设一套简化流程，与其他人分开管理以免拖累整体
把「他就是不行」改写成「流程没给他留接口」，可做的事随之多出一整类
questions.explanation: 转折在概念上：问题从「这个人有缺陷」被改写成「这栋楼没有坡道」，责任方一换，解法空间就扩张了。单独设一套简化流程正是当年被否决的「隔离但平等」方案的翻版；只给同情或只查个人原因，问题仍挂在人身上。
questions.question_en: The real turning point of the 1977 Section 504 sit-in was conceptual. Which application to managing a team fits it best?
options_en: First pin down each struggling member's personal reasons, then decide on a transfer or training
Show struggling members more sympathy and patience, while leaving every existing team process unchanged
Give struggling members their own simplified process, managed separately so they don't drag down the rest
Rewrite "he just can't do it" as "the process leaves him no interface," which opens up a whole new class of fixes
questions.explanation_en: The shift was from "this person is defective" to "this building has no ramp"; moving responsibility expanded the space of solutions. A separate simplified track mirrors the rejected separate-but-equal alternative, and sympathy alone or digging into personal causes still locates the problem in the person.
